items.exampleEn: She has a dislike of crowded places.
My kids are very energetic in the morning.
items.exampleZh: 我的孩子們早上精力非常充沛。

items.exampleEn: Don't be so impatient. The bus will come soon.
items.exampleZh: 別那麼不耐煩，公車很快就來了。

items.exampleEn: His noisy phone calls annoy me.
items.exampleZh: 他講電話很吵，讓我很煩。

items.exampleEn: The teacher was happy with the children's behavior.
items.exampleZh: 老師對孩子們的行為表現很滿意。

items.exampleEn: She has the ability to speak four languages.
items.exampleZh: 她有說四種語言的能力。

items.exampleEn: I had trouble finding your house.
She has a fear of dogs.

items.sentenceEn: We need an energetic person for this job.
items.sentenceZh: 這份工作需要一個有活力的人。

items.audioEn: I had trouble sleeping last night because of the noise.
items.audioZh: 因為噪音，我昨晚很難入睡。

items.sentenceEn: We talked about our likes and dislikes.
items.sentenceZh: 我們聊了彼此喜歡和不喜歡的東西。

items.sentenceEn: He gets impatient when he has to wait.
items.sentenceZh: 他只要一等就會不耐煩。

items.stemEn: The noise from the street really ____ me. I can't sleep.
items.stemZh: 街上的噪音真的讓我很煩，我都睡不著。

items.stemEn: He has a great ____ to make people laugh.
items.stemZh: 他很有逗人發笑的能力。

items.passageEn: Our dog, Coco, is very energetic. She loves running, but she has one strange fear: she is afraid of water. Giving her a bath is always trouble. Coco also has a dislike of cats, and her noisy behavior often annoys our neighbors. My father gets impatient with her, but my mother says, "She has the ability to learn. Don't be impatient with her."
items.passageZh: 我們家的狗 Coco 精力非常充沛。牠很愛跑，但有一個奇怪的恐懼：牠怕水。幫牠洗澡總是很麻煩。Coco 也討厭貓，牠吵鬧的行為常常惹惱鄰居。我爸爸會對牠不耐煩，但我媽媽說：「牠有學習的能力，別對牠不耐煩。」

options: Coco 學得會，別對牠不耐煩
應該把 Coco 送給鄉下的親戚

referenceEn: When I was a child, I had a fear of the dark.
I had a fear of the dark when I was young.
rubricZh: 「怕⋯」可寫例如 had a fear of、was afraid of
小時候的事用過去式（例如 had、was）

items.instructionZh: 用 have trouble 造一個句子，說說你做某件事有困難。
referenceEn: I have trouble getting up early.
I had trouble finding a seat on the train.
rubricZh: have trouble 後可接例如動詞 -ing、with＋名詞（getting up、with math）
時態配合句意（例如 have、had）
